biggest_catch: Variable gig pay (85% of your own set rate after the 15% fee) with no guaranteed bookings — and the platform is Europe-only, so it is useless if you are not in a supported country.
catches: Gudog takes a 15% service fee on every booking — sitters keep 85% of their set rate.
Sitters set their own rates, so pay is variable with no guaranteed bookings.
Europe-focused (Ireland, Spain, France, Germany, Denmark, Norway, Sweden, UK) — no US presence; demand varies by city.
All bookings must go through Gudog to keep veterinary cover and secure payments.
You are an independent sitter; earnings depend on reviews, response speed, and availability.

steps: Register as a dog sitter on Gudog (free).
Build your profile with services (boarding, day care, walking, visits), rates, and availability.
Accept booking requests; meet & greet with the owner and dog.
Complete the service; Gudog deducts its 15% fee and you receive the rest.
timing: Paid per completed booking via the platform.
